signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.body: ZenthOs signs you in through GitHub. Your workspaces decide what you see: create one for your team, or be invited into one.
signIn.afterwards: New here? You will name your first workspace right after signing in.
signIn.notSetUp: ZenthOs has no GitHub App yet, so nobody can sign in. The operator sets it up once.

runs.title: Runs
runs.empty: No runs yet. Start one with a ticket key, or add the zenthos:run label on an issue.

run.clickToInspect: Click a step to inspect it
run.graphAria: The run's state machine with the path this run took
run.costNote: Estimates come from the agents' own token counts at list price; the invoice is the Console's number.

offRamp.needs_human: This run left the path and waits for a person: resume it from the state it was in, or abandon it.
offRamp.failed: This run failed and will not continue.

settings.title: Settings

setup.title: Set up ZenthOs
setup.intro: Three steps before the first run. Each one turns green as soon as it is true.
setup.install: Install the app on an account
setup.installHint: Any GitHub account or organisation you belong to; choose the repositories it may act on.
setup.repoHint: Which commands may run, which ones gate a pull request, and the limits of a run.
setup.key: Enter the workspace's model API key
setup.keyHint: An Anthropic API key from your own Console workspace; the runs bill there. Checked before it is stored, sealed at rest, never shown again.

settings.notInstalled: Nothing installed for this workspace yet. Install the app on an account or organisation to let it act on repositories.
settings.notCovered: No installation of this workspace covers this repository, so runs will fail to act on it.
settings.confirmRemoveRepo: Remove the profile for {{repo}}? Runs for it will be refused.
settings.manageHint: Add or remove the repositories this installation may act on, on GitHub; the list here follows.
settings.addThisRepo: Install the app on it on GitHub
settings.installedBanner: GitHub sent you back: the installation below is now this workspace's.
settings.noPlatform: The ZenthOs GitHub App is not set up yet. The operator does that once on the setup page.
settings.confirmRelease: Release the installation on {{account}} from this workspace? The app stays installed on GitHub until its owner removes it there.

modelKey.title: Model provider
modelKey.none: No key yet. Runs of this workspace need one; until then the worker can only use the deployment's own credentials, if it has any.
modelKey.label: Anthropic API key
modelKey.hint: Create the key in the Anthropic Console under a workspace with a spend limit. ZenthOs checks it with Anthropic, stores it sealed, and shows only its last four characters from now on.
modelKey.confirmRemove: Remove this workspace's key? Its runs will fail until a new one is entered, unless the deployment has credentials of its own.

repoForm.allowedHint: Exact lines; nothing else runs in the sandbox.
repoForm.gatesLabel: Gate commands: must exit 0 before a pull request opens
repoForm.noAllowed: Add allowed commands first; gates are picked from them.
repoForm.forbidden: Extra forbidden path prefixes, one per line
repoForm.forbiddenHint: A change touching these needs a person.
repoForm.alwaysForbidden: Always forbidden: the files that define the gates
repoForm.pickHint: Start typing to pick one of the repositories the app is installed on; the default branch and clone URL come from GitHub.

metrics.title: Metrics

sourceHint.runs: Computed by the API from the stored runs
sourceHint.scm: Needs GitHub: who changed the code before the merge
sourceHint.evals: Lives in the eval baselines, per prompt version
sourceHint.approvals: Needs time spent by people, which nothing records yet

elsewhere.scm: Not computed yet: it needs each merged pull request's commits from GitHub, to tell the bot's from a person's.
elsewhere.evals: Not computed here: the eval suites measure it per prompt version (pnpm nx run @zenthos/worker:eval); their baselines are the number.
elsewhere.approvals: Not computed yet: nothing records how long a person spent; the wait for an approval is not the time spent on it.

metrics.runsTitle: Runs, cost by agent, and LangFuse
metrics.runsIntro: Each run's estimate split by the agent that spent it. All three agents are traced in LangFuse, so each share can be checked there.
metrics.notSplit: recorded before costs were split by agent
metrics.unavailable: The API has no LangFuse keys (LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY, LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY), so nothing was compared.

workspaceNew.title: Name your workspace
workspaceNew.body: A workspace holds a team: its members, GitHub installations, repositories and runs. You will be its owner, and you can invite others by GitHub login.
workspaceNew.name: Workspace name

members.title: Members
members.inviteHint: They get access the next time they sign in with that GitHub account.

setupPage.title: Set up the ZenthOs GitHub App
setupPage.body: ZenthOs acts on GitHub through one app, created once for this deployment and installed by each team on its own accounts. GitHub opens with the app described; you confirm and come back here.
setupPage.tokenHint: Printed by the API when it starts without an app.
setupPage.name: App name
setupPage.ownerHint: Leave empty to create it under your account
setupPage.done: The app {{slug}} is set up. Sign in to create your workspace and install it.
